name: glass
title: Glass
description: A liquid glass lens that refracts live DOM through an SVG displacement filter, with chromatic dispersion and a bright rim, in Chrome, Safari and Firefox. No dependencies.
author: Sam Asante <https://github.com/samasante>
docs:
Installed `Glass` (with `GlassMaterial`, `GlassSurface` and the motion helpers) in `components/ui/glass*.ts(x)`. Import from `@/components/ui/glass`.

- `<Glass className="rounded-full bg-white/25 px-4 py-2">Save</Glass>`: a plain wrap is a glass material (frost, tint, bright edge everywhere; the live-page bend is Chrome and Edge only).
- `<Glass size={160} center={{ x: 0.4, y: 0.5 }}><Hero /></Glass>`: bends its own children in place, in every browser.
- `<Glass refract={<Wallpaper />} width={420} height={84} radius={20}>...</Glass>`: a panel over content it does not own.
- `<Glass draw={(ctx, t) => paint(ctx, t)} size={160} />` or `src="/clip.mp4"`: refracts a canvas or a video with WebGL 2.

Give the wrapper a translucent background: an opaque one hides the refraction. No dependencies.
